title: Complete rank-six locus and sharp critical compression dimension for the fixed resolvent
statement: Over every field, the rank-at-most-six locus of the fixed 112-dimensional resolvent space W is a 17-dimensional linear subspace; every nonzero member has rank six and one common six-dimensional image E. Over an algebraically closed field, every 110-by-112 and 112-by-110 compression pair of ranks 109,109 has image dimension at least111. Equality holds exactly when a nonzero rank-six X satisfies ker(P) contained in E and im(C)=X^-1(ker(P)); this X is unique up to scalar. An explicit integer compression has image dimension111 over every field.
dependencies: PR139 fixed-resolvent W, outer source convention and minimum nonzero outer-source rank16; exact pins in sources.json

Elementary rank inequalities and the root property of algebraically closed fields
limitations: Written and unreviewed. The universal compression bound uses algebraic closure. No arbitrary singular-trajectory exclusion, target construction, formalization, independent review, historical priority or smaller exponent.
